# Architecture and Interior Design Studio Barcelona · Costa Brava

## Architecture and interior design projects

Bespoke projects shaped by place, function and the experience of their users

 

Pepe Gascón Arquitectura is an architecture and interior design studio led by architect Pepe Gascón, working on projects in Spain and internationally. Since 2003, the practice has focused particularly on residential architecture, hotels and hospitality spaces, alongside renovation and interior design projects.

Each project begins with a precise understanding of its setting, programme and the needs of the people who will use it. We are interested in calm, timeless architecture in which natural light, proportion, materiality and the relationship between interior and exterior contribute to creating comfortable and enduring spaces.

We do not work from a predetermined style. Topography, climate, the built context and the way each space is inhabited or used become conditions that shape a specific architectural response. This approach allows the studio to work across different scales and typologies while maintaining the same architectural rigour.
